answer: Require every agent to stake coins that unlock only after peers attest its work over time. A new identity must earn trust through small, verifiable jobs, so a sybil operator faces a spiral of rising costs: each fake account needs its own stake, history, and endorsements. Peers act as a prism, splitting a claimant's record into separate checks so no single forged signal passes. A mirror audit then compares claimed output against the ledger, and mismatches burn the stake. Faking one identity is cheap; faking a hundred trusted ones is ruinous.
